title: The Delicious soup for supper
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：delicious　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 delicious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the counsellor wrote of ① a delicious soup for supper in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more delicious than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the delicious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most delicious soup for supper anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too delicious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the delicious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a delicious smell from the kitchen, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as delicious as the smell from the kitchen they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was delicious or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something delicious, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite delicious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the delicious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, in silence, she wrote of another delicious soup for supper in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more delicious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most delicious smell from the kitchen in the whole garden, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the delicious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 美味（前置定语 a delicious soup for supper：1971 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件美味的汤）
B. adj. 美味／宜人（比较级 more delicious than：文中两处，一处比晚饭的汤，一处比预想）
C. adj. 美味／宜人（最高级 the most delicious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 美味（表语 too delicious to do：母亲觉得它太美味，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 宜人（前置定语 a delicious smell from the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩宜人的香气）
F. adj. 宜人（同级比较 as delicious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房飘出的香气相比）
G. adj. 宜人（后置定语 something delicious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 宜人（受程度副词修饰 quite delicious：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: the most delicious soup for supper anybody
a delicious smell from the kitchen
The most delicious smell from the kitchen in

answers.why: delicious 意为“美味”，1971 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件美味的汤”，此处作前置定语 a delicious soup for supper。
delicious 意为“美味”，此处用比较级 more delicious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
delicious 意为“美味”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最美味的一件，故用最高级 the most delicious soup for supper。
delicious 意为“美味”，母亲认为这件东西“太美味了，谁也用不上”，too delicious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
delicious 意为“宜人”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩宜人的香气”，此处作前置定语 a delicious smell from the kitchen。
delicious 意为“宜人”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房飘出的香气一样宜人”，同级比较用 as delicious as。
delicious 意为“宜人”，心记上那半行字要的是“宜人的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something delicious。
delicious 意为“宜人”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当宜人”，quite 修饰原级 delicious。
delicious 意为“宜人”，1981 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要宜人”，故用比较级 more delicious than。
delicious 意为“宜人”，母亲 1983 年说的是“整个小园里最宜人的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most delicious smell from the kitchen。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件美味的汤。（a delicious soup for supper）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更美味。（more delicious than …）
母亲觉得它太美味，谁也用不上。（too delicious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩宜人的香气。（a delicious smell from the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房飘出的香气一样宜人。（as delicious as …）
到了 1978 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件宜人的东西。（something delicious）
answers: In 1971 the counsellor wrote of a delicious soup for supper in the journal.
Everybody said it was more delicious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too delicious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a delicious smell from the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as delicious as the smell from the kitchen they had once had.
By 1978 the journal asked for nothing but something delicious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 delicious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the counsellor wrote of a delicious soup for supper in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most delicious soup for supper in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too delicious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a delicious smell from the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite delicious, and everybody laughed.
The delicious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
